env_vars.dxvk_fullscreen: Forces DXVK to use an exclusive or controlled fullscreen mode for Vulkan applications through DXVK.
env_vars.dxvk_async: Enables asynchronous shader compilation with DXVK to reduce stuttering caused by shader compilation during gameplay.
env_vars.dxvk_config: Defines DXVK configuration options directly through an environment variable.
env_vars.dxvk_filter_device_uuid: Selects a Vulkan device by its UUID.
env_vars.dxvk_hud: Displays the DXVK overlay (FPS, memory, shaders).
env_vars.dxvk_config_file: Defines the path to the DXVK configuration file.
env_vars.dxvk_shader_cache: Enables or disables the DXVK shader cache.
env_vars.dxvk_shader_cache_path: Defines the path to the DXVK shader cache.
env_vars.vkd3d_log_file: Defines the file in which VKD3D-Proton writes its logs.
env_vars.vkd3d_vulkan_device: Forces VKD3D-Proton to use a specific Vulkan device.
env_vars.vkd3d_filter_device_name: Selects the Vulkan device by name.
env_vars.vkd3d_disable_extensions: Disables specific Vulkan extensions used by VKD3D-Proton.
env_vars.vkd3d_swapchain_present_mode: Forces the Vulkan presentation mode of the swapchain.
env_vars.vkd3d_shader_cache_path: Defines the path to the VKD3D-Proton shader cache.
env_vars.vkd3d_shader_dump_path: Defines the VKD3D-Proton shader export directory.
env_vars.vkd3d_shader_override: Allows certain VKD3D-Proton shaders to be overridden.
env_vars.proton_use_d7vk: Direct3D 7 - Uses D7VK instead of DXVK/D3D9.
env_vars.proton_enable_nvapi: Enables NVIDIA NVAPI support in Proton to allow certain NVIDIA-specific features to be used.
env_vars.proton_enable_wayland: Enables Wayland support in Proton when available.
env_vars.proton_enable_hdr: Enables HDR support for compatible games through Proton. Deprecated in Proton-CachyOS, where HDR is handled automatically.
env_vars.proton_discord_bridge: Enables the Discord Rich Presence bridge integrated into Proton. Allows certain games to communicate their presence to Discord.
env_vars.proton_use_optiscaler: Enables OptiScaler integration in GE-Proton. Depending on the game, this allows modern upscaling techniques to be used.
env_vars.proton_sony_dualsense_as_dualsh: Makes a DualSense/DualSense Edge appear as a DualShock 4 to the game. Useful for games that support DS4 but not DualSense.
env_vars.proton_sony_hidraw_xinput: Converts Sony DS4/DualSense/DualSense Edge controllers to XInput. Useful when games incorrectly detect PlayStation controllers or their mappings.
env_vars.proton_steaminput_xinput_fallba: Creates a Steam Input device and forwards XInput controllers to it. Useful for games requiring Steam Input, particularly with Wine-Wayland.
env_vars.proton_wayland_monitor: Selects the Wayland monitor used by Proton. Example: PROTON_WAYLAND_MONITOR=HDMI-A-1 %command%
env_vars.proton_use_ntsync: Enables NTSync, a more efficient synchronization method designed to improve CPU performance and compatibility with Windows games.
env_vars.winealsa_channels: Forces the number of audio channels exposed by WineALSA: 2 = stereo, 4 = 4 channels, 6 = 5.1, 8 = 7.1. Useful for resolving sound and audio spatialization issues.
env_vars.wine_fullscreen_fsr: Enables or disables the use of FSR (FidelityFX Super Resolution) for fullscreen upscaling in Wine/Proton.
env_vars.wine_vk_fullscreen_method: Defines the method used by Wine to handle Vulkan fullscreen mode (e.g. desktop, exclusive, auto).
env_vars.sdl_video_x11_net_wm_bypass_com: Controls whether SDL requests the X11 compositor to bypass composition. Can reduce latency or rendering issues, but may cause focus or mouse capture problems with some window managers.
env_vars.sdl_mouse_auto_capture: Enables automatic mouse capture when the window becomes active. Improves mouse behavior in fullscreen or FPS-style games by preventing loss of mouse control.
env_vars.sdl_mouse_relative_mode_warp: Enables relative mouse mode with pointer warping. Used by some older games to simulate continuous mouse movement. Can improve compatibility with DirectDraw or legacy engines.
env_vars.sdl_video_minimize_on_focus_los: Determines whether the window should be minimized when it loses focus. Useful for avoiding unstable fullscreen behavior in older games.
env_vars.sdl_hint_grab_keyboard: Forces SDL to capture the keyboard when the window is active. Prevents key input from leaving the game context, improving immersion and compatibility with legacy engines.
env_vars.amd_vulkan_icd: Selects the AMD Vulkan ICD (RADV or AMDVLK) used by applications.
env_vars.mesa_vk_device_select: Selects a Vulkan GPU through Mesa.
env_vars.mesa_shader_cache_max_size: Sets the maximum Mesa shader disk cache size to keep more compiled shaders and reduce shader recompilation when launching games.
env_vars.mesa_gl_version_override: Forces the OpenGL version reported by the Mesa driver to applications.
env_vars.mesa_glsl_version_override: Forces the GLSL shader language version used by Mesa for shader compilation.
env_vars.gl_shader_disk_cache: Enables the NVIDIA shader disk cache to store compiled shaders and reduce compilation times and stuttering during gameplay.
env_vars.gl_shader_disk_cache_skip_clean: Prevents automatic cleanup of the NVIDIA shader disk cache, keeping compiled shader data available for longer.
env_vars.ld_preload: Loads shared libraries before those normally used by the application.
env_vars.gamemoderun: Launches the game through GameMode to automatically apply gaming-oriented system optimizations.
env_vars.steam_compat_app_id: Sets the Steam app ID used for compatibility.
env_vars.steam_compat_client_install_pat: Specifies the installation path of the Steam client used by Proton to locate the files, libraries, and components required to run Windows games.
env_vars.steam_compat_mounts: Specifies additional directories to mount inside the Steam/Proton compatibility environment, making files or libraries accessible to the game.
env_vars.steam_compat_data_path: Defines the Steam/Proton compatibility prefix path containing the Wine environment used by the game (configuration, registry, DLLs, and virtual system files).
env_vars.steam_compat_tool_paths: Defines the path to the Steam/Proton compatibility tools used by the game (Proton runtime, Wine components, DXVK, VKD3D, and other required libraries).
env_vars.steam_compat_shader_path: Sets the path to the Steam shader cache.
env_vars.mangohud_dlsym: Enables MangoHud dynamic dlsym injection mode to improve detection of applications using dynamically loaded graphics libraries.
env_vars.mangohud_cpu_sensor: Selects the CPU sensor used by MangoHud to display temperature, clock speed, or other hardware information when multiple sensors are available.
env_vars.mangohud_config: Defines MangoHud configuration parameters (display, metrics, FPS limit, position, and overlay options).
env_vars.mangohud_opengl: Enables MangoHud OpenGL rendering support to display the overlay with applications using OpenGL.
env_vars.mangohud_verbose: Enables or disables verbose MangoHud initialization messages.
env_vars.vblank_mode: Controls Mesa VSync: 0 = off, 1 = on, 2 = on except for user-controlled applications, 3 = on.
env_vars.gst_plugin_path: GStreamer plugin path. Leave empty to avoid conflicts with system or Proton plugins.
env_vars.gst_debug: GStreamer debug level. 0 disables all logging.
env_vars.wine_disable_gstreamer: Disables Wine GStreamer integration to prevent multimedia errors and broken dependencies.
env_vars.gst_registry_reuse_plugin_scann: Reuses the GStreamer plugin scanner process to reduce plugin discovery time and improve startup performance.
env_vars.gst_plugin_feature_rank: Changes the priority of GStreamer plugins, codecs, and features to prefer or disable specific components.
env_vars.use_d3d11: Forces the use of the Direct3D 11 renderer instead of newer DirectX versions.
env_vars.useallavailablecores: Instructs Unreal Engine to use all available CPU cores for game processing.
